capabilities: Create interactive timelines with events, spans and nested eras
Define custom calendars with own months, leap days and era numbering
Link timeline cards to vault notes and sync dates in properties
Embed timeline excerpts in notes via an evra code block
Export timelines as Markdown tables or outlines
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests; requires Obsidian 1.6 or later and runs on desktop, phone and tablet; .evra files are copied by Obsidian Sync only when 'Sync all other types' is enabled; note sync is off by default; linking timelines into trees and branch timelines are planned but not built.
motivation: The README says most timeline tools assume our calendar and our kind of history, and that Evra is built for the ones users make up.
problem: Obsidian has no timeline view and its date handling assumes the real-world calendar, so invented histories with custom months, eras and leap-day rules cannot be mapped visually.

relations.evidence: You can start from a preset, or import a calendar from Calendarium or Fantasy-Calendar.
You can start from a preset, or import a calendar from Calendarium or Fantasy-Calendar.

summary: Interactive timeline tool for fictional worlds with custom calendars, nested eras, story spans, and cards linked to vault notes, stored as .evra files.
